steps.what: Show the stored test for this assembly.
Set up and operate test equipment to diagnose performance.

tasks.design: The {DOCS} store shows the test already specified for this electronic component, assembly, or system. The engineering technician sets up and operates the specialized or standard test equipment to diagnose, test, or analyze performance. The specification does not run the test. A station that already records is not this time.
tasks.previous_blocker: A performance figure was filed from the station, and the technician had not set the equipment up.
tasks.enabler_now: The stored test can be opened. The setup and the operation still belong to the technician.
tasks.still_hard: A result the specification does not describe still has to be seen on the instrument.
tasks.human_edge: The technician sets up and operates the test. The stored test is the instruction already written.
tasks.altitude: Setup, operation, and diagnosis stay with the technician. The station's own recording is not this labour.

reach.task: Use a test this technician actually ran.
reach.learn: A stored limit is not the diagnosis.

evidence.claim: Opening a stored test is a lookup. It does not set up, operate, or diagnose with the test equipment.
Time a test station already spends recording a figure is not the technician's setup or operation.

assumptions: Workflow boundary: An engineering technician in a mid-size European company. A stored drawing is not the circuit, and a draft is not the accepted record.
Fields: The test id already stored. The screen does not mark the performance diagnosed. If a required field is missing, the step stops and the engineering technician finishes it by hand.
Native check: Open the test instruction before setting up the equipment.
A test station, drawing tool, controller, bill generator, or statistical program that already runs is not in these shares.
unknowns: Whether specialized and standard tests share one record.
research_questions: Who confirms the test instruction matches the assembly on the bench?

already_counted.description: Setting up, operating, and diagnosing with the test equipment stay with the technician.

incremental.description: Drop tests whose assembly record has been withdrawn.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The technician still sets up and operates the test equipment to diagnose, test, or analyze performance. Only opening a test that was already specified is removed. A station that already records saves none of that work.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Estimate cost and prepare the budget.

steps.what: Calculate material cost estimates from stored prices.
Prepare project schedules, budgets, and design specifications.

tasks.design: The {ERP} holds a quantity and a price already stored. The material cost line is the quantity times that price, and a missing price stops the line. The engineering technician calculates the design specification and prepares the project schedule and the budget. A scheduler that already runs is not this time. Only the budget the technician accepts is filed.
tasks.previous_blocker: A budget used a price from another part, and the quantity for this job was empty.
tasks.enabler_now: A stored quantity and price can be multiplied. The specification, the schedule, and the budget still belong to the technician.
tasks.still_hard: A resource the price table does not list still has to be estimated by the technician.
tasks.human_edge: The technician prepares the schedule and the budget. The cost line is not that judgement.
tasks.altitude: The specification, schedule, and budget stay with the technician. They are filed only after that version is accepted.

reach.task: Use a budget this technician has accepted.
reach.learn: A price without a quantity is not an estimate.

evidence.claim: Multiplying a stored quantity by a stored price is arithmetic. It does not prepare a schedule, a budget, or a design specification.
A missing price is not a price. A scheduler that already runs is not the technician's time.

assumptions: Workflow boundary: An engineering technician in a mid-size European company. A stored drawing is not the circuit, and a draft is not the accepted record.

Fields: The quantity and the price already stored. A missing price stops the line. The schedule and the design specification are not added by the multiplication. If a required field is missing, the step stops and the engineering technician finishes it by hand.
Native check: Multiply stored quantity by stored price. Do not invent a price or a delivery date.
Any edit after approval voids the version and returns the item to the engineering technician.
A test station, drawing tool, controller, bill generator, or statistical program that already runs is not in these shares.
unknowns: Whether material prices and resource prices share one table.
research_questions: Who confirms the price table is the one for this project?

already_counted.description: Preparing the design specification, the schedule, and the budget stays with the technician.

incremental.description: Drop prices whose part record has been withdrawn.

approvals.approved_version: project id, cost lines, and the budget the technician accepted

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The technician still calculates the design specification and still prepares the project schedule and budget. Only multiplying a quantity and a price that were both already stored, and filing the budget already accepted, is removed. A missing price saves none of that work.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Show the stored procedure for this equipment.
Educate equipment operators on proper use.

tasks.design: The {DOCS} store shows the procedure already written for this equipment. The engineering technician educates the operators on the proper use. The procedure is not the lesson. A procedure with no id leaves the education with the technician.
tasks.previous_blocker: An operator was marked trained because a procedure existed, and the lesson had not happened.
tasks.enabler_now: The stored procedure can be opened. The education still has to happen.
tasks.still_hard: A misuse the procedure does not mention still has to be covered in the lesson.
tasks.human_edge: The technician educates the operators. The procedure is the note already written.
tasks.altitude: The lesson stays with the technician and the operators. The stored procedure is only visible.

reach.task: Use the equipment the way this technician taught.
reach.learn: A procedure title is not the lesson.

evidence.claim: Opening a stored procedure is a lookup. It does not educate an operator.
Marking a procedure as read is not the same as teaching the proper use.

assumptions: Workflow boundary: An engineering technician in a mid-size European company. A stored drawing is not the circuit, and a draft is not the accepted record.
Fields: The procedure id already stored. The screen does not mark an operator trained. If a required field is missing, the step stops and the engineering technician finishes it by hand.
Native check: Open the procedure before the lesson.
unknowns: Whether each equipment type has its own procedure record.
research_questions: Who confirms an operator has been taught, rather than only assigned the procedure?

already_counted.description: Educating the operators stays with the technician.

incremental.description: Drop procedures whose equipment record has been withdrawn.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The technician still educates the equipment operators on the proper use. Only opening a procedure that was already written is removed. A procedure title saves none of the lesson.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Show the functional specification and the catalogue row.
Select electronics equipment or components for that functional need.

tasks.design: The {DOCS} store shows the functional specification and any catalogue row already stored. The engineering technician selects the electronics equipment, component, or system that meets it. The catalogue row is not the selection. Only the selection the technician accepts is filed.
tasks.previous_blocker: A component was copied from a catalogue title and did not meet the functional specification.
tasks.enabler_now: The stored specification and the catalogue row can be opened. The selection still belongs to the technician.
tasks.still_hard: Two rows that both look close still have to be judged against the specification.
tasks.human_edge: The technician selects the equipment. The catalogue row is not that choice.
tasks.altitude: The selection stays with the technician. It is filed only after that version is accepted.

reach.task: Buy equipment this technician has selected.
reach.learn: A catalogue title is not the selection.

evidence.claim: Opening a catalogue row is a lookup. It does not select equipment against a functional specification.
Filing a selection before the technician accepts that version would store a choice nobody made.

assumptions: Workflow boundary: An engineering technician in a mid-size European company. A stored drawing is not the circuit, and a draft is not the accepted record.

Fields: The specification id and the catalogue row already stored. The selection is not added by the screen. If a required field is missing, the step stops and the engineering technician finishes it by hand.
Native check: Open the functional specification before choosing a catalogue row.
Any edit after approval voids the version and returns the item to the engineering technician.
unknowns: Whether equipment, components, and systems share one catalogue.
research_questions: Who confirms the catalogue row is still supplied?

already_counted.description: Selecting the equipment or component stays with the technician.

incremental.description: Drop catalogue rows whose part record has been withdrawn.

approvals.approved_version: specification id, catalogue id, and the selection the technician accepted

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The technician still selects the electronics equipment, component, or system against the functional specification. Only opening a specification and a catalogue row that were already stored, and filing the selection already accepted, is removed. A catalogue title saves none of that choice.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: The engineering technician still sets up the test, still prepares the schedule and the budget, still educates the operator, and still selects the equipment. A stored price or a catalogue row can be opened. It does not make the choice.
reach: Operators learn the procedure from this technician, and a stored note is not the lesson.
Buyers hear a selection only after this technician has accepted it.
skills_to_grow: Operate the test equipment. Do not treat a stored limit as the diagnosis.
Price a line only when the quantity and the price are both stored.
Select equipment against the functional specification, not against a catalogue title.
role.ambitious_version: Testing, estimating, teaching, and selection stay with the technician. Stored rows only show what was already written.

job.title: Electrical and Electronic Engineering Technologists and Technicians
